none: PAS BUC-2BEF34: Roman radiate of Carasius
contea di ritrovamento: Somerset (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP CARAVSIVS [P F AVG] ; R/ LEG (V?)[II?] [CONS]

A copper alloy radiate (antoninianus) of Carausius (AD 286-93). Reece Period 14 [275-296]. Obverse description: Radiate draped bust right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS [P F AVG]. Reverse description: A bull advancing right, CAR AVG in exergue. Reverse inscription: LEG (V?)[II?] [CONS]. C Mint, around the time of the CXXI Legio VII Claudia issues for Legio VII Claudia. RIC - This is one of three examples known which together enable us to reconstruct the legends as: IMP CARAVSIVS P F AV(G). LEG (VII?) [CO]NS, CAR AVG (Legio VII, the Protector of our Augustus, Carausius). This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
